items.title: Forged SAML assertion accepted because the signature is not fully validated
RelayState used after login sends employees to an attacker's site
Internet-facing admin portal has no second factor or network restriction for admin sessions
Admin access granted from a role attribute the user can influence
Captured assertion can be replayed to log in as that employee
XML signature wrapping lets an attacker swap assertion contents past signature checks
Revoked or demoted employees keep admin access because roles are only read at login
